def factor_range_compression_breakout_gated_balanced(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    range_ = df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"]
    range_mean = range_.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
    range_std = range_.rolling(20, min_periods=20).std(ddof=1)
    range_z = (range_ - range_mean) / range_std.replace(0, np.nan)

    volume = df_copy["volume"]
    vol_ratio = volume / volume.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
    vol_mean = vol_ratio.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
    vol_std = vol_ratio.rolling(20, min_periods=20).std(ddof=1)
    vol_z = (vol_ratio - vol_mean) / vol_std.replace(0, np.nan)

    compression = -range_z - vol_z
    momentum = df_copy["close"].pct_change(5)
    raw = compression * momentum

    # ADX regime gating
    high = df_copy["high"]
    low = df_copy["low"]
    close = df_copy["close"]
    tr1 = high - low
    tr2 = (high - close.shift(1)).abs()
    tr3 = (low - close.shift(1)).abs()
    tr = pd.concat([tr1, tr2, tr3], axis=1).max(axis=1)
    atr = tr.rolling(window=14, min_periods=1).mean()
    up_move = high - high.shift(1)
    down_move = low.shift(1) - low
    plus_dm = np.where((up_move > down_move) & (up_move > 0), up_move, 0.0)
    minus_dm = np.where((down_move > up_move) & (down_move > 0), down_move, 0.0)
    plus_di = 100.0 * (pd.Series(plus_dm, index=high.index).rolling(window=14, min_periods=1).mean() / atr.replace(0.0, np.nan))
    minus_di = 100.0 * (pd.Series(minus_dm, index=high.index).rolling(window=14, min_periods=1).mean() / atr.replace(0.0, np.nan))
    dx = 100.0 * (plus_di - minus_di).abs() / (plus_di + minus_di).replace(0.0, np.nan)
    adx = dx.rolling(window=14, min_periods=1).mean()
    adx_weight = 1.0 / (1.0 + np.exp(-0.5 * (adx - 20.0)))

    factor = raw * adx_weight
    factor = factor.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0)
    df_copy["factor_range_compression_breakout_gated_balanced"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_range_compression_breakout_gated_balanced"]
description: Mutation of compression breakout factor to balance the range and volume components. The original used raw volume ratio, which may have larger amplitude than the range z-score, causing one to dominate. This variant z-scores the volume ratio over a 20-day rolling window, putting both compression signals on equal scale. The core mechanism remains compression intensity times momentum, and the lightweight ADX trend gate is preserved. This aims to improve combinatorial stability (RankICIR) and potential IC without changing the economic logic.
